title: NHK Documentary — 富士山：霊峰の四季 (Mt. Fuji: Sacred Peak Through the Seasons)
description: An NHK nature documentary following Mt. Fuji through all four seasons. Features alpine wildlife, mountain climbers, the 富士講 pilgrimage tradition, and the spiritual significance of Japan's highest peak (3,776 m). Narration uses N3–N4 Japanese with some specialized nature and history vocabulary.
creator: NHK
